blocks.text: “Doctor X: Mafia in White,” starring Kim Ji-won, is facing criticism over its medical accuracy, with viewers arguing that the medical drama’s depiction of medical procedures is undermining the series’ realism and disrupting immersion. The series centers on Gye Soo-jung (Kim), a brilliant yet maverick surgeon who challenges the corrupt power dynamics and political structures governing hospital administration. Its first two episodes aired on Friday and Saturday on SBS, securing nationwide viewership ratings of 11.4 percent and 14.9 percent, respectively, according to data from Nielsen Korea.
